hooks.command: sh -c 'for d in "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/tools/setup.mjs" ] && exec node "$d/tools/setup.mjs" hook; done; f=$(find "$HOME/.codex/plugins/cache" "$HOME/.copilot" "$HOME/.claude/plugins" -path "*cartwright*/tools/setup.mjs" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1); [ -n "$f" ] && exec node "$f" hook; exit 0'

sh -c 'command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; for d in "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$PLUGIN_ROOT"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/tools/guard.mjs" ] && exec node "$d/tools/guard.mjs" pre-tool-use; done; s="${CARTWRIGHT_STATE_DIR:-$HOME/.cartwright}/plugin-root"; [ -f "$s" ] && d=$(cat "$s") && [ -f "$d/tools/guard.mjs" ] && exec node "$d/tools/guard.mjs" pre-tool-use; exit 0'
